title: Act: Add characters schema, animation resolver and Phaser character rendering
summary: Data-driven characters rendered and animated in BootScene
description: Add characters to sceneSchema and SceneDef, a pure resolver, preload of character spritesheets and Phaser sprites in BootScene driven by yaml.
acceptance_criteria: sceneSchema accepts characters with required animations.idle
resolveCharacterAnimation returns manifest animation or idle fallback
BootScene creates sprites for each character and plays idle then interact on objectClick
definition_of_done: Boy defined in bedroom.yaml and animates in BootScene

steps.action: Add characterSchema with id, name, position {x,y}, scale default 1, layer default 'characters', animations record with required idle and optional walk and interact, each {asset: string, animation: string}; add optional characters array to sceneSchema; export CharacterSpec type.
steps.code: export const characterSchema = z.object({ id: z.string(), name: z.string(), position: z.object({x:z.number(),y:z.number()}), scale: z.number().positive().default(1), layer: layerSchema.default('characters'), animations: z.object({ idle: animRef, walk: animRef.optional(), interact: animRef.optional() }) })
steps.expected: sceneSchema.parse accepts a characters list and rejects missing idle

steps.action: Add optional field characters?: CharacterSpec[] (import type from ../content/schema) to SceneDef.

Export resolveCharacterAnimation(spec: CharacterSpec, name: 'idle'|'walk'|'interact', manifest: AssetManifest): {asset: string; animation: string}. Use spec.animations[name]; if absent, or its asset is missing from manifest.assets or lacks that animation in asset.animations, return spec.animations.idle.
steps.expected: Returns idle ref for missing or unknown entries

steps.action: After the objects loop add a loop over scene.characters ?? [] adding every animations.*.asset id to refs.
steps.code: for (const c of scene.characters ?? []) for (const a of Object.values(c.animations)) if (a) refs.add(a.asset)

steps.action: In preload, for entries of type spritesheet call this.load.spritesheet(entry.id, `assets/${entry.path}`, {frameWidth: entry.frames.frameWidth, frameHeight: entry.frames.frameHeight}). In create, for each scene.characters entry register anims via this.anims.create keyed `${asset}:${animation}` from the manifest animation, add a sprite at position with origin from the manifest, play the idle key, and in the objectClick handler play interact then idle on animationcomplete.
steps.expected: Boy sprite idles and plays interact on click

steps.action: Add a characters list with id boy, name The Boy, position {x:150,y:140}, animations idle {asset: character:boy, animation: idle}, walk {asset: character:boy-walk, animation: walk}, interact {asset: character:boy-interact, animation: interact}.
